stories.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
stories.simple_summary: Three safety researchers who were fired from OpenAI say the company's claims about them mishandling sensitive information are wrong. They worry that firing them will scare other people at OpenAI from speaking up about safety concerns.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people who work in AI companies and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI Answers Get Cheaper as Model Choices Multiply
stories.simple_summary: Different AI companies are competing with each other, which is making AI services less expensive.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a small business considering AI tools to help with your work, prices may become more affordable over time.

stories.title: Trump gets mocked for saying those who say 'artificial intelligence' are enemies
stories.simple_summary: A political figure made a comment about AI that people found amusing or wrong.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly political commentary — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon Just Issued a Blunt Warning About Artificial Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of JPMorgan Chase bank said something serious about AI's risks or importance.
stories.why_it_matters: When major business leaders warn about AI, it's worth paying attention to what changes might be coming to banking or businesses — though the article doesn't say what the specific warning was.

stories.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
stories.simple_summary: Actor Ben Affleck sold an AI filmmaking company to Netflix and has shown he knows a lot about how AI actually works, not just the buzzwords.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly shows that AI filmmaking is becoming real — but for now it's mainly relevant to entertainment companies and investors.

stories.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
stories.simple_summary: A company that ranks and tests different AI models received a large investment of $200 million and is now worth $3.1 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI, one of the biggest AI companies, is making much less money than people thought it was — about $50 billion less per year.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and shows that even popular AI companies aren't as profitable as assumed — nothing you need to act on immediately.

stories.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
stories.simple_summary: Google is adding features to its Gemini AI so it can work like an employee — planning work, doing tasks, and even getting its own email address to use business apps.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business using Google tools, this could eventually help automate routine tasks for you, though it's just starting with large businesses first.

stories.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
stories.simple_summary: A company that makes an AI called Claude created new rules against people using it for bad things like election interference, weapons, or endless abuse.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly a company policy update — if you use Claude, you just need to know it has clearer rules now, but normal use is fine.

stories.title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released solutions to math problems that don't follow the quality standards that math researchers expect.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to math researchers and AI engineers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
stories.simple_summary: USA Today newspaper is suing OpenAI because it claims OpenAI used hundreds of thousands of the newspaper's articles to train its AI without permission or payment.
stories.why_it_matters: This is one of many lawsuits against AI companies over using published content — the outcome could eventually affect how AI companies get training material, though it won't affect you right away.

stories.title: SpaceXAI backs Omarchy, the controversial Linux distro, with $1.5 million in compute
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk's company SpaceXAI donated computing power to support a Linux software project.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical donation mostly relevant to software engineers — nothing you need to act on.
